item.title: By: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description:
Danish Henrik Gemal ponders “I wonder why Google are so interested in doing usability studies for tab browsing in Mozilla Firefox?”

I’m not into any conspiracy like thoughts here, I just think this is a funny view, and may reflect that it’s not often that we hear about user testing of open source products.
